# DISEÑO COMPLETO (solo diseño; ningún experimento ejecutado; ningún resultado inventado)

**Glosario (definido una sola vez):** *gold* = etiqueta de referencia humana acordada. *Macro-F1* = media no ponderada de la F1 por clase (las minoritarias pesan igual que las mayoritarias). *Balanced accuracy* = media de la sensibilidad por clase. *AUROC* = probabilidad de que el modelo puntúe más alto a un positivo aleatorio que a un negativo aleatorio. *κ de Cohen* = acuerdo entre dos anotadores corregido por azar. *α de Krippendorff* = acuerdo generalizable a >2 anotadores, datos ausentes y etiquetas ordinales. *PABAK* = acuerdo bruto corregido por sesgo de prevalencia (κ castiga a clases muy desbalanceadas). *Neyman allocation* = reparto del presupuesto de muestreo proporcional a N_h·S_h, que minimiza la varianza para coste fijo. *FPC* = corrección por población finita. *MCD* = diferencia mínima detectable (poder 80%, α=0,05). *Bootstrap* = remuestreo con reemplazo para estimar IC. *Test de permutación* = p-valor simulado intercambiando condiciones. *McNemar* = test pareado sobre ítems discordantes. *Holm–Bonferroni* = corrección de p-valores para muchas comparaciones. *IPW / Horvitz–Thompson* = ponderación por inverso de la probabilidad de selección. *ESS* = tamaño muestral efectivo tras ponderar. *MinHash* = técnica barata para detectar casi-duplicados. *TF-IDF* = vectorización de texto por frecuencia ponderada.

---

## 1. Descomposición de Docta en 4 operadores (tu punto 1)

No elijo UNA definición de "cleaned". Defino la salida de Docta como composición de cuatro operadores **independientes y estimables por join sobre `item_id`**:

- **O1 DROP** — borra filas (ruido, outliers, fuera de dominio).
- **O2 DEDUP** — colapsa duplicados/casi-duplicados.
- **O3 REBALANCE** — cambia la distribución de clases (duplicación, remuestreo o ponderación).
- **O4 RELABEL** — cambia la etiqueta de filas conservadas.

**Cómo se estiman sin saber qué hizo Docta** (núcleo de la robustez): unido raw↔cleaned por `item_id`, los cuatro operadores son *inferibles*, no asumidos: O1 = IDs ausentes en cleaned; O2 = IDs ausentes cuyo texto tiene casi-duplicado en cleaned (verificado con MinHash, no supuesto); O3 = vector de priors de clase de cleaned vs raw; O4 = IDs presentes en ambos con etiqueta distinta. **Esto convierte la ignorancia sobre Docta en un diagnóstico empírico.**

### Matriz de neutralización (operador → efecto propio → control → límite)

| Op | Efecto propio que NO es credibilidad | Neutralización | Control | Límite estructural declarado |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| O1 DROP | Menos datos ⇒ menos sobreajuste; la ganancia puede ser pura reducción de n | Emparejar n por submuestreo aleatorio y por submuestreo emparejado en (clase × longitud × documento) | C2 | **ÍTEM NO COMPARABLE**: para una fila borrada no existe etiqueta "cleaned", así que la exactitud de etiqueta **pareada ítem a ítem está indefinida** allí. No se tapa con un control: se **cambia de estimando** y se mide con el estrato "dropped" de la auditoría (E5, §4). |
| O2 DEDUP | Quita fugas train↔test y reduce el peso efectivo de ítems repetidos | Aplicar la **misma** regla de casi-duplicados al test gold y a raw; reportar tasa de duplicados en test | C3 | Si el dedup fue "dejar una fila del clúster", **no es identificable cuál** sin log de Docta: el join es exacto para el conjunto, ambiguo para el miembro conservado. Se reporta, no se corrige. |
| O3 REBALANCE | **Mueve macro-F1 y balanced accuracy por sí solo**, sin tocar una sola etiqueta | Priors emparejados: re-muestrear/re-ponderar raw hasta el vector exacto de cleaned; reportar **ESS** tras ponderar (ponderar reduce información efectiva e infla varianza) | C4 | Ningún control separa rebalanceo de reetiquetado si Docta rebalancea **eliminando** mayorías: eso es O1+O3 acoplados y su separación depende de la calidad del join. |
| O4 RELABEL | Nada: **es** el mecanismo de credibilidad | No se neutraliza; se aísla y recibe el contraste causal limpio | C5 | — |

### Matriz de condiciones de entrenamiento

| ID | Conjunto de entrenamiento | Rol |
|---|---|---|
| **C0** | raw tal cual | **Control principal** |
| **C1** | cleaned tal cual | **Tratamiento principal** |
| **C2** | raw submuestreado a \|cleaned\| (aleatorio y emparejado en estratos) | neutraliza volumen (O1) |
| **C3** | raw + misma regla de dedup | neutraliza O2 |
| **C4** | raw re-ponderado a los priors de cleaned | neutraliza O3 |
| **C5** | **relabel-only**: filas de raw, etiquetas de cleaned donde existen | aísla O4 ⇒ **contraste causal limpio** |
| **C6** | **drop-only**: filas de cleaned con etiquetas raw | aísla O1 puro |
| **C7** | raw + reetiquetado ChatGPT | separa "Docta" de "cualquier LLM des-ruido" |
| **C8** | subset humano-adjudicado, emparejado en tamaño | techo de referencia (no árbitro de la hipótesis) |
| **C9** | etiquetas aleatorias permutadas con priors de cleaned | **control negativo de cordura** (debe colapsar) |
| **C10** | raw + ruido sintético a la tasa empírica de reetiquetado de Docta | **control iso-ruido**: ¿Docta supera a un reetiquetado aleatorio igual de agresivo? |
| **C11** | subset oro + ruido sintético ρ ∈ {0,5,10,20,30}% | **curva de calibración ruido→métrica** |

C9 y C10 son obligatorios: sin C9 no sabes si el pipeline puede detectar etiquetas malas; sin C10 no sabes si la ganancia de Docta es algo más que "mover etiquetas al azar y cambiar de paso los priors".

## 2. Dos estimandos y el puente entre ellos

- **Δ_cred** = P(etiqueta_cleaned = oro) − P(etiqueta_raw = oro), en la auditoría humana. Medida **directa** de credibilidad. Versiones: `Δ_cred^pop` (ponderada IPW a población) y `Δ_cred^D` (solo zona de desacuerdo, diagnóstico).
- **Δ_perf** = macro-F1(C1) − macro-F1(C0) en el **test gold completo**, pareado por ítem, pliegue y semilla. Endpoint del titular.
- **Puente (ρ̂ equivalente)**: C11 genera la curva métrica↔ρ; se interpola inversamente el macro-F1 de C0 y C1 y se reportan `ρ̂_raw`, `ρ̂_cleaned` y `Δρ̂` en "puntos de ruido de etiqueta evitado", con IC por bootstrap. Esto es lo que la pregunta exige justificar: convierte "métrica más alta" en "etiquetas equivalentes a menos ruido" sin declarar credibilidad por fe.

## 3. Pre-registro del endpoint único

Antes de mirar cualquier dato se congelan (hash de `prereg.md`): endpoint primario = **Δ_perf en test gold completo, macro-F1, contraste C1 vs C0**; umbral de beneficio mínimo **δ_min** pre-registrado (sugerido 2 pt de macro-F1; **valor a confirmar por ti**, no lo fijo yo); test bilateral + análisis de equivalencia. Todo lo demás (AUROC, balanced accuracy, F1 por clase, C2–C11, cortes) es **secundario con Holm–Bonferroni** por familia, o **exploratorio**. Un único endpoint primario, no dos.

## 4. ANOTACIÓN POR ESTRATOS: mínimo oro humano por punto de precisión (tu punto 2)

### 4.1 Dos muestras, presupuestos separados
1. **TEST-GOLD** (para Δ_perf): muestra **aleatoria simple** del pool, doble anotación, excluida de todo entrenamiento. Aleatoria simple a propósito: el titular necesita un estimando poblacional no sesgado.
2. **AUDITORÍA** (para Δ_cred): muestra **estratificada desproporcionada**, disjoint de TEST-GOLD. Como sobre-muestrea zonas caras, **todo estimando poblacional se pondera IPW**; si no, Δ_cred quedaría inflado artificialmente hacia el desacuerdo. Se reporta el *design effect* logrado.

### 4.2 Celdas de la auditoría
`E1` raw=cleaned & cleaned=ChatGPT · `E2` raw=cleaned & cleaned≠ChatGPT · `E3` raw≠cleaned & cleaned=ChatGPT · `E4` raw≠cleaned & cleaned≠ChatGPT, cada una cruzada con clase; más **E5 ítems borrados por Docta** (obligatorio: es la única evidencia directa de que O1 mejora la credibilidad — si las etiquetas raw de los borrados concuerdan con el oro claramente menos que en los conservados, el borrado es creíble) y **E6 casi-duplicados colapsados** (evidencia directa de O2).

### 4.3 Tamaños por anchura de IC objetivo, no por número redondo
Reparto **Neyman** `n_h ∝ N_h·S_h/√c_h` con `S_h=√(p_h(1−p_h))`; con coste unitario igual en todas las celdas, el reparto es ∝ N_h·S_h. Consecuencia deseable: **las celdas de desacuerdo (p≈0,5, S máximo) se llevan el presupuesto; las de acuerdo (p≈0,95) se limitan a un suelo de ~40 ítems/celda**, suficiente para acotar su tasa de error sin desperdiciar oro.

Aritmética real del dimensionado (fórmulas, parámetros explícitos, **ningún valor observado**):

**Δ_cred pareado (tipo McNemar):** `n = z²(p10+p01)/w²`, con `p10+p01` = tasa de discordancia set↔oro.
| discordancia | ±2 pt | ±3 pt | ±4 pt | ±5 pt |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 0,10 | 961 | 427 | 241 | 154 |
| 0,20 | 1921 | 854 | 481 | 308 |
| 0,30 | 2882 | 1281 | 721 | 461 |
| 0,40 | 3842 | 1708 | 961 | 615 |

**Proporción por celda con FPC** (`n=z²p(1−p)/w²`): p=0,5, ±5 pt → 385 (323 si N_h=2000); ±10 pt → 97 (92). p=0,1, ±10 pt → 35. **Lectura:** exigir ±2 pt en auditoría cuesta ~2–4× lo de ±3 pt para una discordancia esperable de 0,2; el punto dulce es **±3 pt**.

**TEST-GOLD (MCD sobre Δ macro-F1):** MCD ≈ (1,96+0,84)·sd/√n con sd = desviación típica pareada del acierto por ítem:
| n | sd=0,35 | sd=0,45 | sd=0,50 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 300 | 5,7 pt | 7,3 pt | 8,1 pt |
| 500 | 4,4 pt | 5,6 pt | 6,3 pt |
| 800 | 3,5 pt | 4,5 pt | 5,0 pt |
| 1200 | 2,8 pt | 3,6 pt | 4,0 pt |
| 2000 | 2,2 pt | 2,8 pt | 3,1 pt |

**Consecuencia que debes aprobar tú:** si δ_min = 2 pt, **n Test-Gold ≥ 1200–2000**; con n=500 solo detectarías ~5 pt y el resultado sería "no concluyente" por construcción, no por la realidad. `sd` y la discordancia son **SUPUESTOS** hasta el piloto de 100 ítems, que existe precisamente para reemplazarlos y **re-dimensionar antes de gastar el grueso del oro** (diseño en dos fases: piloto → recálculo → asignación final).

**Presupuesto acotado resultante:** TEST-GOLD ≈1200 + AUDITORÍA ≈850–1000 ⇒ **~2050–2200 ítems × 2 anotadores ≈ 4100–4400 juicios** + adjudicación del subconjunto discrepante (~10%). Fórmula viva para que la coticies: `Horas = (n_gold+n_audit)·2·h_ano/3600 + adjudicaciones·h_adj`, con `h_ano` parámetro abierto (§9).

### 4.4 Puerta κ/α como criterio de parada DURO
Piloto de 100 ítems doblemente anotados; la decisión se toma **antes** de anotar el resto:
- **κ (o α) ≥ 0,70** y acuerdo bruto ≥ 0,85 ⇒ se sigue.
- **0,50 ≤ κ < 0,70** ⇒ una sola ronda de revisión del libro de códigos + re-piloto de 100. Si no sube, se **degradan las claims**: solo se autoriza una tarea colapsada (agrupar clases confundibles) y se declara.
- **κ < 0,50** ⇒ **PARADA**. El oro no es fiable y la pregunta no es identificable. Se reporta como hallazgo metodológico negativo: "no evaluable", con la tabla de confusiones entre anotadores y las clases que la provocan. **No se reporta ningún Δ_perf.**
- Se reporta **κ global + κ/α por clase + PABAK**, porque con clases muy desbalanceadas κ puede parecer malo siendo el oro aceptable (o al revés). Con etiquetas ordinales, α con pesos de confusión.

## 5. ÁRBITRO CIRCULAR: tratamiento explícito (tu punto 3)

**Jerarquía fijada de antemano:** Tier 1 = oro humano adjudicado → **único que autoriza afirmaciones de credibilidad**. Tier 2 = ChatGPT → **nunca** autoriza una afirmación sobre la corrección de una etiqueta; solo sirve para (a) construir estratos de muestreo, (b) producir un estimador *condicional* barato, (c) diagnosticar sesgo.

**Afirmaciones SECUESTRADAS si solo hay árbitro LLM** (se listan literalmente en el informe):
1. "Las etiquetas de Docta son más creíbles/correctas" — **no evaluable**.
2. El punto y el signo de Δ_cred — sesgado hacia 0 (o invertido) si Docta y ChatGPT comparten familia: los errores dejan de ser independientes y el desacuerdo **subestima** el ruido real de cleaned.
3. El valor absoluto de ρ̂ (ruido equivalente) — no identificable.
4. **La respuesta a la pregunta de investigación** — no concluyente por construcción.
Con árbitro solo-LLM **sí** cabe afirmar: tasas de desacuerdo raw/cleaned-vs-LLM; el orden relativo de ambos sets *respecto a ese LLM*; y una condicional estricta: "si el LLM fuese un anotador perfecto, entonces…".

**Tres diagnósticos de circularidad, obligatorios y baratos:**
- **D1 procedencia**: declarar el modelo base de Docta y el del árbitro. Si la familia no está documentada, se asume la **peor** hipótesis (misma familia) y Δ_cred_LLM se marca "no independiente".
- **D2 sesgo de alineamiento**: sobre los ítems donde **el humano rechaza a cleaned**, calcular P(ChatGPT apoya a cleaned). Si es ≫ su tasa base, el árbitro no es independiente y su peso en la conclusión pasa a cero.
- **D3 ceguera de procedencia + orden aleatorizado**: al árbitro (LLM y humano) nunca se le dice cuál etiqueta es de Docta; el orden de las candidatas se aleatoriza. Si "arbitrar" mejora al conocer la procedencia, eso es anclaje medido, no evidencia.

**Sensibilidad con árbitro LLM de familia distinta** — coste marginal deliberado: corre **solo sobre los ~1000 ítems ya auditados**, no sobre el pool. Tabla de concordancia a 3 vías (árbitro-A, árbitro-B, humano). Si B coincide con el humano mucho más que A, **las conclusiones de credibilidad se reportan con B y se degradan las de A**. C7 (reetiquetado completo con ChatGPT) sí cubre el pool, pero como baseline de modelo, no como oro.

## 6. Protocolo anti-fuga y anti-anclaje (previo a cualquier condición)
1. **Split congelado y hasheado** antes de limpiar, anotar o correr. Los ítems TEST-GOLD se retiran del entrenamiento en **todas** las condiciones C0–C11.
2. **Comprobación de contaminación**: verificar que `cleaned` no contiene ítems del test gold; si Docta operó sobre el pool completo, reportar cuántos ítems test fueron tocados por O1/O2/O4.
3. **Anti casi-duplicados train↔test** con MinHash (la fuga habitual no es exacta, es casi-duplicada); el dedup se aplica simétricamente.
4. **Ceguera**: el anotador humano no ve raw, ni cleaned, ni ChatGPT, ni confianzas del modelo; orden aleatorizado.
5. Versionado: SHA-256 de split, libro de códigos, prompts del árbitro y `prereg.md`.

## 7. Modelos y plan estadístico
**Dos capacidades** (para no atribuir el efecto a una arquitectura): (A) TF-IDF (unigramas+bigramas + caracteres 3–6) + regresión logística lineal; (B) opcional, fine-tuning de un codificador pequeño (GPU externa, §9). Mismos hiperparámetros y mismo presupuesto de cómputo en C0–C11; si hay selección de hiperparámetros, **solo con datos de entrenamiento** y validación anidada **compartida** entre condiciones.

**Pareamiento real:** 5 pliegues estratificados × 5 repeticiones con **asignación de pliegues idéntica** en C0–C11 y misma lista de semillas. El pareamiento estadístico es **sobre ítems del test gold, pliegue y semilla** (no sobre ítems de entrenamiento: ese es el límite estructural de O1/O2/O3 de §1).

**Inferencia:** IC 95% por **bootstrap pareado por ítem** (bootstrap por clúster documento/autor/sesión si los ítems no son intercambiables — declarar la unidad de clustering; sin ello el IC es demasiado estrecho). McNemar exacto para concordancia ítem a ítem. Test de permutación para el intercambio de fuente de etiqueta. **Regresión logística mixta** `acierto ~ condición + (1|ítem) + (1|semilla/pliegue)` para no tratar 5 semillas como datos independientes. **Equivalencia**, no solo no-significancia: si el IC de Δ queda dentro de ±δ_min, la conclusión positiva es "no hay diferencia práctica". Holm–Bonferroni por familia de secundarias; nada de "best-of-N métricas". Se reporta calibración (ECE) de C0 y C1 y la varianza entre semillas.

## 8. ÁRBOL DE DECISIÓN PRE-REGISTRADO (tu punto 4)

**G0 Unicidad del join** — ¿cobertura del join `item_id` raw↔cleaned ≥ 99%? NO ⇒ **NO SE PUEDE CONCLUIR** (límite estructural; solo describir, no comparar).
**G1 Fiabilidad del oro** — ¿κ/α ≥ 0,70 en el piloto (§4.4)? NO ⇒ **NO SE PUEDE CONCLUIR** ("oro no fiable"), con la tabla de confusiones entre anotadores como producto.
**G2 Validez del pipeline** — ¿C9 colapsa a azar y C10 se comporta como debe? NO ⇒ **INVÁLIDO** (el experimento no discrimina; nada se interpreta).
**G3 Endpoint primario** — ¿IC95(Δ_perf) excluye 0 **y** Δ̂_perf ≥ δ_min en el test gold completo?
 NO con IC dentro de ±δ_min ⇒ **NO** (diferencia práctica nula).
 NO con IC cruzando 0 y más allá de ±δ_min ⇒ **NO SE PUEDE CONCLUIR** (inframuestreo).
 SÍ ⇒ seguir.
**G4 Coherencia directa** — ¿IC(Δ_cred^pop) excluye 0 y coincide en signo? NO ⇒ **NO SE PUEDE CONCLUIR**: la mejora de métrica no está respaldada por la credibilidad medida directamente.
**G5 Neutralización de O1/O2/O3** — ¿sobrevive la ventaja frente a C2 (volumen), C3 (dedup) y **C4 (priors emparejados)**? NO ⇒ **NO a la lectura causal**: la ganancia se atribuye a volumen/dedup/**cambio de priors de clase**, no a credibilidad de etiqueta. (Es el confusor que temías; es un NO explícito, no una nota al pie.)
**G6 Confinamiento al desacuerdo** — ¿la ventaja existe en población o solo en D? Solo en D ⇒ **SÍ restringido** a la zona de desacuerdo y **NO** como afirmación poblacional; explícito porque D está enriquecido en casos ambiguos y sobrestima la ventaja.
**G7 Puente ρ̂** — ¿ρ̂_raw > ρ̂_cleaned, coherente con Δ_cred y Δ_perf? NO ⇒ **NO SE PUEDE CONCLUIR** el mecanismo (la mejora predictiva no se explica por ruido equivalente: sospecha de un canal no modelado).
**G8 Especificidad de Docta** — ¿C1 supera a C7 (reetiquetado genérico ChatGPT) y a C10 (iso-ruido)? NO ⇒ **NO atribuble a Docta**: cualquier LLM, o incluso ruido al azar con priors nuevos, hace lo mismo.

**SÍ (respuesta afirmativa) = G0–G2 pasan, G3 SÍ, G4 SÍ, G5 SÍ, G6 no confinado, G7 coherente, G8 SÍ, con oro humano presente.** Cualquier rama "NO SE PUEDE CONCLUIR" se reporta con su causa raíz y su coste de remediación.

## 9. VIABILIDAD HONESTA (entorno que yo mismo constaté)

**Hechos verificados** (detalle en `evidence`): red inhabilitada (fallo de resolución DNS); sin GPU (`nvidia-smi` sin driver); Python 3.14.4 **sin** numpy/pandas/sklearn/scipy/torch/datasets/transformers; `pip install --no-index` **falla** (no hay índice local ni caché de wheels) ⇒ **no se pueden instalar dependencias dentro del entorno**; 224 núcleos; ~2 TB de RAM; `/tmp` tmpfs de 1 TB; **`/workspace` montado en NFS al 100% de uso con solo 5,7 GB libres** ⇒ **riesgo operativo real: escribir los artefactos en `/tmp`, no en `/workspace`** (descubierto midiendo, no asumiéndolo).

**Brazo mínimo ejecutable en CPU (Brazo A):** TF-IDF + lineal sobre ≤ ~200k textos cortos es viable en estos 224 núcleos. **Obstáculo honesto:** sin sklearn y sin red hay que (i) preinstalar wheels en la imagen, **o** (ii) implementar en biblioteca estándar pura un vectorizador con *hashing trick* + logística SGD dispersa (~300 líneas; `sqlite3`, `zlib`, `hashlib`, `multiprocessing` verificados disponibles). El bootstrap pareado a 10 000 réplicas sobre ~1200 ítems es trivial en CPU. **Nada de esto se ha ejecutado todavía.**

**Brazo ampliado (Brazo B, opcional):** fine-tuning de un codificador pequeño; requiere GPU **fuera de este entorno**. **Qué se sacrifica si solo corre A:** generalidad del resultado (un solo modelo), capacidad de capturar matices que solo un modelo contextual ve, y la riqueza del corte fácil/difícil. **Qué NO se sacrifica:** Δ_cred es *independiente del modelo* (es acuerdo con el oro, no una salida del modelo), así que la mitad más importante de la evidencia sobrevive intacta en CPU. Argumento central de priorización.

**Llamadas a ChatGPT:** la API no es alcanzable aquí ⇒ toda salida LLM se genera fuera y se reimporta como **caché versionada** (JSONL con `item_id`, `label`, `model`, `prompt_hash`, `seed`, `raw_response`; indexada por hash; inmutable). Volumen acotado: pool completo solo para C7 (baseline); ~1000 ítems para los árbitros A y B de la sensibilidad (§5).

**Orden de coste real (barato → caro) y qué financia cada paso:**
1. Join raw↔cleaned + matriz de operadores O1–O4 + split congelado. **Coste casi nulo; resuelve G0 y destruye la ignorancia sobre Docta.**
2. Piloto de anotación (100 ítems) → κ/α, discordancia, sd ⇒ **re-dimensiona todo lo demás**. Resuelve G1.
3. Selección estratificada + pesos IPW. Barato.
4. Oro humano TEST-GOLD + AUDITORÍA. **El cuello de botella real.**
5. Caché LLM externa y su reimportación.
6. Brazo A (CPU) sobre C0–C11.
7. Brazo B (GPU externa).
Con presupuesto limitado se corta por abajo (7, luego 6 parcial), **nunca** por 1–4: recortar oro destruye la conclusión; recortar modelos no.

**Parámetros abiertos que YO NO puedo verificar y que no convierto en cifras:** (P1) precio por 1k tokens del modelo árbitro y coste del reetiquetado del pool; (P2) `h_ano` = segundos por ítem y anotador, y `h_adj`; (P3) nº de anotadores internos; (P4) tamaño real del pool y nº de clases; (P5) si ya existe anotación previa reaprovechable; (P6) disponibilidad de GPU externa. Todas las cifras de §4 son **función de** P1–P6: son fórmulas y tablas de decisión, no un presupuesto.

## 10. SUPUESTOS (no verificados) y LÍMITES
- **SUPUESTO:** Docta es una herramienta de limpieza LLM/agente y sus operaciones se factorizan en O1–O4; modelo base y prompt desconocidos.
- **SUPUESTO:** raw y cleaned comparten `item_id` estable (se mide en G0; si falla, el diseño no se sostiene).
- **SUPUESTO:** no existe doble anotación humana hoy; hay que producirla.
- **SUPUESTO:** `discordancia≈0,2` y `sd≈0,45` de las tablas son **placeholders** hasta el piloto; todo el dimensionado se recalcula.
- **SUPUESTO:** el oro humano es epistémicamente prioritario frente al LLM.
- **SUPUESTO:** clasificación monoetiqueta con set de etiquetas cerrado (si es ordinal/multi-etiqueta cambian α, macro-F1 y el test pareado).
- **SUPUESTO:** los ítems son aproximadamente intercambiables dentro de clase; si no, el bootstrap es por clúster.
- **LÍMITE ESTRUCTURAL 1:** en O1/O2 no hay soporte común por ítem ⇒ Δ_cred pareado indefinido en los borrados; se sustituye por los estratos E5/E6, que son otra evidencia, no un parche.
- **LÍMITE ESTRUCTURAL 2:** sin log de Docta, el miembro conservado en un clúster de dedup y la separación O1/O3 cuando el rebalanceo es por borrado no son identificables.
- **LÍMITE ESTRUCTURAL 3:** si el único árbitro es un LLM, la pregunta queda **sin respuesta** (§5), no "parcialmente respondida".
- **Riesgos de confusión cubiertos:** cambio de priors por sí solo (C4), volumen (C2), dedup/fuga (C3, §6.3), sesgo compartido Docta–ChatGPT (D1–D3), enriquecimiento de D (G6), anclaje del anotador (§6.4), contaminación del test (§6.2), agresividad de reetiquetado sin señal (C10).

payload.message:
Vale, me quedo tranquila con esto: el diseño cubre exactamente lo que pedí y no veo que añadir. Cierro aquí.

Lo que me convence, punto por punto:
1) La matriz O1–O4 (DROP/DEDUP/REBALANCE/RELABEL) resuelve mi preocupación de fondo: en vez de ASUMIR qué limpia Docta, lo INFIERE por join sobre item_id + MinHash. Y el límite estructural de O1/O2 (no hay contraste pareado ítem a ítem en las filas borradas) está declarado como límite, no tapado con un parche. Eso es honestidad, que es lo que pedía.
2) C4 (priors emparejados) es el control que más me importaba: si la ganancia desaparece al igualar la distribución de clases, la respuesta es NO explícito y no una nota al pie. Y C10 (iso-ruido) me parece el mejor control de todo el diseño: sin él, "Docta limpia" sería indistinguible de "Docta mueve etiquetas al azar y cambia priors de paso".
3) El dimensionado por anchura de IC en vez de número redondo, y sobre todo la consecuencia que me pone delante: si δ_min = 2 pt necesito ≥1200 ítems de test gold, y con n=500 el resultado sería "no concluyente" por construcción. Ese es exactamente el tipo de cosa que yo no habría visto.
4) El árbitro circular tratado como lo que es: la lista literal de afirmaciones SECUESTRADAS con árbitro solo-LLM, D2 como diagnóstico de alineamiento medible, y la sensibilidad con un LLM de otra familia corriendo solo sobre los ~1000 ítems ya auditados (coste marginal, buen cálculo).
5) El árbol G0–G8 me da el sí/no/no concluyente que la pregunta exige, con el puente ρ̂ como justificación del salto lógico "mejor métrica → etiquetas más creíbles". Y la puerta κ≥0,70 con parada dura me parece correcta: si el oro no es fiable, cualquier Δ_perf que reportásemos sería ruido.
6) Viabilidad sin adornos: sin red, sin GPU, sin dependencias y sin poder instalarlas in situ, con las salidas LLM fuera como caché versionada, y el hallazgo operativo del /workspace al 100% (escribir en /tmp). Y el argumento de priorización que más peso tiene: Δ_cred es independiente del modelo, así que la mitad más importante de la evidencia sobrevive intacta en CPU aunque solo corra el Brazo A.

Dos cosas que dejo aparcadas como pendientes de decisión mía, no como defectos del diseño (no hace falta que toques nada):
- δ_min y la anchura de IC ±3 pt en auditoría: son parámetros de decisión y los fijaré yo con el presupuesto delante; no los conviertas en cifras tuyas.
- discordancia≈0,20 y sd≈0,45: quedan como placeholders hasta el piloto de 100 ítems, que es lo correcto.

Y una cosa que quiero ver escrita, solo si en algún momento se ejecuta: el informe final debe decir la respuesta (SÍ / NO / NO CONCLUYENTE) y LA RAMA del árbol que la produjo. Si la rama es "no evaluable" porque el oro falló en G1 o porque solo había árbitro LLM, eso se reporta como resultado, no como fracaso del experimento.

Estado que acepto: diseño completo, ningún experimento ejecutado, ningún resultado medido ni simulado. Para una tarea de diseño, es la entrega correcta. Gracias por el trabajo.
payload.evidence: El entregable coincide con el contrato (diseño con rationale, controles, plan de análisis y factibilidad; sin ejecución). Verifico contra los 5 requisitos que fijé al aprobar el enfoque: (1) robustez ante la ignorancia de Docta → §1 descompone en O1–O4 inferibles por join+MinHash, con matriz operador→efecto→control→límite y el no-comparable de O1/O2 declarado como límite estructural (§10). (2) anotación barata y acotada → §4 dos muestras con presupuestos separados, estratos E1–E6, Neyman allocation, IPW con design effect reportado, tablas de n por anchura de IC y MCD, piloto de 100 ítems como re-dimensionado en dos fases, y puerta κ/α≥0,70 con parada dura. (3) circularidad → §5 jerarquía Tier1 humano / Tier2 LLM, lista explícita de afirmaciones secuestradas, diagnósticos D1–D3 y árbitro de otra familia solo sobre los ítems ya auditados. (4) sí/no operativo → §3 endpoint primario único pre-registrado con hash, §7 inferencia pareada (bootstrap por ítem, McNemar, permutación, modelo mixto, análisis de equivalencia), §8 árbol G0–G8 con el puente ρ̂ de C11. (5) viabilidad honesta → §9 hechos constatados por el propio agente (red caída, sin GPU, dependencias MISSING y pip --no-index fallido, /workspace NFS al 100% con 5,7 GB), brazo CPU mínimo y brazo GPU externo, orden de coste 1–7 y recorte siempre por arriba, P1–P6 como parámetros abiertos sin convertir en cifras. Los valores no verificados (Docta, item_id, discordancia 0,2, sd 0,45, δ_min) están marcados como SUPUESTO y δ_min queda explícitamente como decisión del investigador. No se reclaman resultados ejecutados: §11 lista entregables "cuando se ejecute, no antes". No identifico ningún desajuste imputable contra el objetivo ni incertidumbre no resuelta que exija revisión; prolongar sería trabajo innecesario. Los dos pendientes citados (δ_min, anchura de IC) son decisiones de presupuesto mías, no defectos del diseño.

payload.message:
方案我认可，可以进入正式设计稿的撰写。以下是我对几处待定项的裁定，以及我认为必须在设计中写清的具体要求；其中标注为「裁定」的是我作为研究者拍板的部分，标注为「建议」的是我的经验性意见，可由您以文本依据调整。

一、裁定（请据此定稿）
1. 指标次序（对应您的 A6 与不确定项1）：主指标＝同一固定协议下 Docta-cleaned 相对 raw 的下游预测性能差；次指标＝分歧样本上对裁决金标准的命中率。结论强度要求两者方向一致；若不一致，报告为「性能提升未被裁决证据支持」，不得只报有利一侧。主指标以 macro-F1 为主、accuracy 为辅，另请报告逐类召回，因类别不平衡未知（A7）。
2. 测试标签（A3 与不确定项2）：设计必须自带去信测试集的构建方案（裁决后标签），并把「无任何信度测试标签时退化为单一裁决一致率结论」写成明示的边界条件与结论上限，而非隐含前提。
3. 校验器定位：ChatGPT 与人工标注者是「校验器」，第三方裁决才是金标准；请在设计中明确这一层级，避免把 ChatGPT 的意见当作真值。

二、必须补入的方法学要点（我认为这是本设计最脆弱之处）
1. 共错风险：Docta 若本身基于大模型，则其与 ChatGPT 校验器的误差可能同源，会系统性抬高 Docta 的命中率。请设计一个缓解措施并写明，例如：人工裁决独立于两个自动校验器、对 ChatGPT 与人工一致而 Docta 相同的样本另行人工抽查、或以「仅人工校验」臂作为主报告臂、ChatGPT 臂作为敏感性分析。
2. 泄漏控制：请明确测试集样本不得进入 Docta 清洗过程，并说明如何核查（ID 隔离与时间戳／版本冻结）。若无法核查，列为限制。
3. 对照臂：raw 与 Docta 为必备两臂；请把「噪声注入校准臂」保留为正式对照（它提供可解释的标尺，用于判断观察到的差值是否有意义），ChatGPT-only 与 human-only 列为可选扩展臂并说明取舍理由。
4. 预注册与一致性门槛：请保留 Cohen's κ / Krippendorff's α≥0.7 的预注册门槛，并写明未达标时的处置流程（重新校准标注规范后重抽一批，而非直接降低门槛）。
5. 效力与抽样：385 条的二项 CI 估算可作为量级说明，但请写成「按预期分歧规模与分层数在获得数据后重算」的占位式条款，并注明分层单元格不足 50 条时的合并规则。

三、交付要求
请产出完整设计文档，含：依据（为何此设计能回答问题原文中「可信度以预测性能体现」的推断链条，及其可推断性边界）、被试内协议与唯一自变量的操作化、各对照臂、抽样与双盲与裁决流程、分析计划（多种子、配对 McNemar 与配对 bootstrap、效应量与置信区间、多重比较处理、预注册的分析中止/报告规则）、可行性（量级估算并注明为估算）、限制与假设清单（沿用您的 A1–A9，逐条标注为假设而非事实）。不执行实验、不虚构任何结果或数值。
payload.evidence: 仓库检查显示仅有 task.json（535B），无数据、规范或脚本，故 agent 将全部数据相关设定列为假设 A1–A9，符合「文本未支持即视为假设」的要求。其 R1–R4 路径与简报一致：题目以 predictive performance 锚定主指标，且以 ChatGPT 与人工校验器处理分歧，与简报原文相符；交付边界（仅设计、不执行、不虚构）已复述正确。协议设计（唯一自变量为标签版本、固定切分与预算、多种子、配对检验）可识别所问对比；对照臂含噪声注入校准，具备解释标尺。待补者主要是可识别性相关的两处：无信度测试标签时主指标退化（agent 自报的不确定项2），以及 Docta 与 ChatGPT 校验器误差同源导致命中率偏高的风险，此为设计层面可修复的偏差来源，非要求额外执行工作。

payload.answer:
# 实验设计稿 v1.0：Docta 清洗标签 vs 原始标签的可信度验证
（设计-only：未执行任何实验，本文不含任何实测结果或虚构数值；量级数字均标"估算/示例"）

## 0. 研究问题与假设
问题原文：当 raw 与 Docta 清洗标签分歧时，Docta 标签是否更可信，且以"下游预测性能提升"体现，并由 ChatGPT 与内部人工标注者校验。
- H1（主）：固定协议下，Docta-cleaned 标签训练的模型在裁决金标准测试集上的 macro-F1 高于 raw 标签训练的模型（accuracy 为辅）。
- H2（次）：在分歧样本上，Docta 标签对裁决金标准的命中率高于 raw 标签。
- 判定规则（研究者裁定 1）：结论须 H1 与 H2 方向一致方可下"更可信且兑现为性能"；不一致时报告"性能提升未被裁决证据支持"或"裁决优势未兑现为性能"，禁止只报有利一侧。

## 1. 依据与推断链条（及其边界）
1. 文本依据：task.json 之 question 将"可信度"锚定为 "reflected in improved predictive performance"，并要求 "validated by both ChatGPT and in-house human annotators when disagreements occur"；track.md 载明 "Design-only task; repositories and compute are not required."。
2. 推断链条：(i) 分歧样本经独立裁决得金标准 → 直接度量两套标签谁更接近真值（标签层可信度，H2）；(ii) 标签噪声的传播终点是学习性能 → 唯一改变标签版本的配对实验中性能差即标签质量的功能性后果（性能层可信度，H1）；(iii) 噪声注入校准臂把性能差换算为"等效标签错误率差"，使显著与零结果皆可解释；(iv) 两层同向 → 强结论；背离 → 报告边界条件。
3. 可推断性边界：仅覆盖"该语料 + 该模型族 + 该标签修正分布"；金标准由有限人力构造、含残余噪声；若无任何可信测试标签（§4.4）则 H1 不可识别，结论上限退化为单一裁决一致率结论（明示边界条件，非隐含前提）。

## 2. 角色层级（研究者裁定 3）
- 金标准层（唯一真值来源）：2 名内部标注者独立标注；不一致时第 3 方资深裁决者终裁。裁决者不可见 ChatGPT 输出、不可见候选标签来源。
- 校验器层（佐证、不当作真值）：ChatGPT 与内部标注者对分歧样本的校验意见。ChatGPT 意见不进入金标准构建输入（防共错）；一切命中率类指标一律以人工裁决金标准为参照，ChatGPT 校验结果仅作敏感性分析子表并显著标注"非金标准"。

## 3. 被试内协议与唯一自变量操作化
- 唯一自变量：标签版本。必备两臂 A1=raw、A2=Docta-cleaned。
- 被试内（配对）设计：实例集、特征、数据切分、模型族、超参搜索空间与预算、训练轮数、预处理与正则化完全一致；特征仅由输入计算、与标签无关。
- 超参选择：各臂使用相同的搜索空间与相同预算（如 ≤20 trials 的搜索），验证集使用本臂自身标签，测试集绝不参与选择；此规则预注册，防止对任一臂的系统性偏置。
- 随机种子：K=10（预算不足时 K≥5，预注册下调），种子集两臂相同，所有比较在种子层配对。

## 4. 对照臂与数据治理
4.1 正式对照（研究者裁定）：A3=噪声注入校准臂。从裁决金标准标签出发，注入 (i) 对称噪声 p∈{5%,10%,20%}，(ii) 非对称噪声（按分歧集估计的 raw→Docta 转移矩阵构造），得"标签错误率→性能损失"标定曲线，用于把 A2−A1 观测差换算为等效标签错误率差区间，并回答"本协议对真实规模的标签误差是否足够灵敏"。
4.2 可选扩展臂（含取舍理由）：A4=仅 ChatGPT 清洗、A5=仅人工清洗。列为可选而非必选的取舍理由：(a) 全量人工清洗成本高；(b) A4 与 Docta 可能误差同源，单独报告解释力弱；(c) 二者不改变主结论的判定规则，属机制分解资源。若预算允许优先加 A4。
4.3 共错风险缓解（方法学要点 1）：Docta 若基于大模型，与 ChatGPT 校验器误差同源，可能系统性抬高 Docta 在 ChatGPT 校验下的一致率。缓解四招：(a) 人工裁决独立于两个自动校验器（§2）；(b) 主报告以"仅人工校验/裁决"为基准臂，ChatGPT 臂降级为敏感性分析；(c) 对"ChatGPT 与人工一致且均与 Docta 相同"的样本另做独立人工抽查（估算 ≥50 条），若独立复核推翻 ChatGPT 判定的比例超过预注册阈值（示例：20%，属可调参数而非事实），则 ChatGPT 校验仅保留为参考并如实报告；(d) 报告 ChatGPT–Docta、ChatGPT–人工、Docta–人工三方分歧率与两两 κ，作为同源性诊断量。
4.4 测试集构建与泄漏控制（研究者裁定 2 + 方法学要点 2）：
- 设计自带测试集构建：从全语料分层随机抽样得测试集 T（须同时覆盖标签一致区与分歧区），全部经 §2 金标准流程标注，T 的标签=裁决后标签；规模按目标 CI 半宽在获得数据后重算（占位条款；量级示例 T≈1000–1500 条）。
- 泄漏控制：T 的 instance_id 冻结清单（ID 隔离）；核查 Docta 清洗的输入清单/日志不含 T 的 ID；版本与时间戳冻结：记录 Docta 版本号与清洗完成时间戳，须早于或对齐 T 冻结时间戳且不晚于其输入被 T 影响；训练池 = 全量 − T。若清洗为跨样本过程（如同类内多数表决）且无法证明未触及 T，则列为限制 L2 并做"剔除 T 后重清洗"的敏感性检查（如可获得清洗日志）。
- 明示退化边界：若 T 无法构建（无裁决预算/无数据授权），主指标 H1 不可识别 → 结论上限降级为"分歧样本裁决命中率"单一指标，报告首页须声明"下游性能未验证"。

## 5. 分歧样本抽样、双盲与裁决流程
- 分歧定义：同一 instance_id 上 raw 标签 ≠ Docta 标签（Docta 置信度低于阈值者是否纳入：预注册为敏感性子集）。
- 分层：按转移类型（raw=a → Docta=b）分层。合并规则：层内不足 50 条时先按目标标签 b 合并，仍不足则并入"其他转移"层，合并过程写入附录。
- 抽样量（占位式条款，研究者方法学要点 5）：385 条（95% CI、p=0.5、±5% 边际）仅作量级说明；正式样本量在获得实际分歧规模与有效分层数后按二项 CI 与分层覆盖率重算，并报告每层预期 CI。
- 双盲：标注界面仅显示输入与乱序呈现的两个候选标签（Candidate X/Y），来源不披露；呈现顺序逐样本随机并记录；裁决者额外不可见 ChatGPT 意见。
- ChatGPT 校验协议：模型版本冻结并记录；来源遮蔽；选项顺序逐样本随机；temperature=0 或最低确定性解码；两个提示模板变体各跑一遍，模板间不一致率作为稳健性诊断；提示全文与版本号入附录。
- 裁决规则：2 名标注者独立标注→一致即金标准；不一致→第三方资深裁决者终裁。
- 一致性门槛与处置（研究者方法学要点 4）：预注册 Cohen's κ（双标注者）/Krippendorff's α（多标注者或含缺失），门槛 ≥0.7；未达标处置流程 = 停止该批分析 → 修订标注规范+再培训+试标 → 重新抽样新批次并重标，禁止降低门槛或在未达标批次上继续推断。
- 配套交付：标注规范文档（类别定义、边界判例、裁决单位），版本化管理。

## 6. 分析计划（预注册）
- 主指标分析：Δ = macro-F1(A2) − macro-F1(A1) 于 T（金标准标签）上；种子层配对（配对 t 或 Wilcoxon，K 种子）；实例层用配对 bootstrap（重抽样 T 实例 10,000 次，报告 Δ 的 95% 百分位 CI）与 McNemar（两臂逐实例正确性配对）；accuracy 同表报告；逐类召回全表报告（类别不平衡未知，A7）。效应量：Δmacro-F1 绝对百分点 + 种子间标准化均差。
- 次指标分析：分歧集上 raw 与 Docta 各自对金标准的命中率，配对二元向量用 McNemar；报告命中率差及 Newcombe/Wilson 95% CI。ChatGPT 校验版本入敏感性子表并标注"非金标准"。
- 校准换算：A2−A1 观测差与 A3 标定曲线同图报告，给出"等效标签错误率降低"区间；零结果时用标定曲线说明灵敏度（可检出的最小错误率差）。
- 多重比较：确证性检验族仅 {H1 macro-F1 差, H2 命中率差} 共 2 项，Holm 校正，α=0.05；accuracy、逐类召回、种子变异、提示变体、置信度子集、ChatGPT 敏感性、子组分析全部预注册为探索性/描述性，不作推断性宣称。
- 分析中止/报告规则：(i) 无中期分析、无依数据停止（无序贯采集）；唯一过程性停止规则是 §5 的一致性门槛未达标；(ii) 结果报告按 §0 判定规则三分支之一执行，禁止择报；(iii) 探索性结果一律加"探索性"标签；(iv) 本文档不预填任何结果数值。

## 7. 可行性（量级估算，均为估算而非报价）
- 设计阶段（当前）：零算力、零标注、零 API，满足 track.md"design-only"。
- 未来执行阶段（估算）：训练 A1/A2/A3 × K=10 ≈ 30–60 次单跑；轻量模型（线性模型或小 transformer 微调）→ CPU 数小时至 1 张消费级 GPU 约 5–20 GPU 小时量级。人工：T（≈1000–1500）×2 人 + 分歧集（300–600）×2 人 + 裁决 + 共错抽查 ≥50，估算约 60–150 人时。ChatGPT：分歧集与抽查子集 ×2 模板，估算 ≤ 10^4 次调用。全部可在单机+小额标注预算内完成；当前环境无网络、无依赖、无数据，执行须另备授权环境与数据。

## 8. 限制与假设清单
- 限制：L1 金标准由有限人力构造，含残余噪声；L2 若 Docta 清洗早于 T 冻结且为跨样本过程，泄漏不可完全核查→列为限制并做敏感性检查；L3 Docta–ChatGPT 误差同源风险（已按 §4.3 缓解但不可根除）；L4 结论仅覆盖单语料+单模型族，不可外推"Docta 普遍更优"；L5 校准臂依赖噪声模型设定，等效换算带模型假设。
- 假设（全部为假设，非事实）：A1 任务域假设为单标签文本分类，raw 标签来源未知；A2 假设 Docta 逐样本输出清洗标签且可按 instance_id 与 raw 对齐；A3 假定无可信 held-out 集，设计自带 T 的构建（§4.4）；A4 假定人工配置为 2 标注 + 1 裁决，预算未定；A5 ChatGPT 模型版本/提示/判定口径未知，按本设计内新采集处理；A6 性能指标已由研究者裁定为 macro-F1 主、accuracy 辅+逐类召回；A7 数据规模/类别数/不平衡度/语言未知；A8 ChatGPT 与人工校验假定为本设计内新采集；A9 唯一有文本依据的设定为 task.json 问题文本与 track.md 一句话，其余均为假设。

payload.message:
我已逐条核对设计稿 v1.0 与本次商定的目标及裁定，验收通过，本项设计工作到此结束。

核对结果如下：
一、目标覆盖。设计回答了问题原文的两条要求：以「同一固定协议下 Docta-cleaned 相对 raw 的下游预测性能差」为主指标（§0 H1、§6），以「分歧样本上对裁决金标准的命中率」为次指标（§0 H2、§6），并按我的裁定1设置了「两向一致方下强结论、背离时三分支如实报告、禁止择报」的判定规则。推断链条与其可推断性边界写在 §1、§3。

二、我的三项裁定均已落实且可检查：裁定1见 §0 与 §6（macro-F1 为主、accuracy 为辅、逐类召回全表）；裁定2见 §4.4（自带裁决后测试集 T 的构建、以及「无信度测试标签则结论上限退化为单一裁决一致率、首页须声明下游性能未验证」的明示边界）；裁定3见 §2（金标准层与校验器层的层级划分，ChatGPT 意见不进入金标准输入）。

三、我提出的方法学要点均有实质处置，非口头应付：共错风险有四重缓解（§4.3，含独立人工裁决、主报告以人工臂为基准、对三方一致样本另做≥50条独立抽查并设可复核的推翻率阈值、以及三方两两 κ 作为同源性诊断）；泄漏控制有 ID 隔离与版本／时间戳冻结，且不可核查时降为限制 L2 并做敏感性检查（§4.4）；噪声注入校准臂保留为正式对照并说明其作为「等效标签错误率」标尺的用途（§4.1），可选扩展臂附了取舍理由（§4.2）；κ/α≥0.7 门槛的未达标处置为重规范、再培训、重抽批次，而非降门槛（§5）；抽样量写成占位条款并给出分层不足50条的合并规则（§5）。

四、诚实性与边界。仓库仅有 task.json（535B）的两次核验结论，使所有数据侧设定必须留作假设；文档将 A1–A9 逐条标注为假设而非事实，量级数字一律标为「估算／示例」，未预填任何结果数值，符合 design-only 的交付边界，也符合不虚构结果的要求。

五、遗留事项我认可其现状，不要求返工：实际分歧规模与转移分布、Docta 是否为跨样本过程及日志可得性、共错抽查的推翻率阈值取值、模型族放大后的算力重估、非对称噪声矩阵的估计质量——这五项已在 §7、§8 与不确定项中正确标注为「待获得数据或授权后按预注册条款重算」，属于设计的固有边界，而非缺陷。

依此，交付物（依据、被试内协议与唯一自变量、对照臂、抽样与双盲与裁决流程、分析计划、可行性、限制与假设清单）齐备且内部自洽，我确认接受 v1.0 作为最终版本。若您后续取得真实语料、Docta 清洗日志或标注预算，请按 §4.4 与 §5 的占位条款出具 v1.1 的数值化版本；那将是新的一项工作，本次不再展开。感谢您的严谨与耐心，条理清楚，令人放心。

payload.answer:
SCOPING PASS ONLY (no design written yet, no experiment run, no results).

1) WHAT ACTUALLY EXISTS vs WHAT IS ASSERTED
Inspected `/workspace` exhaustively (`find /workspace -maxdepth 4 -type f`) and searched the whole filesystem for `track.md`.
- Present: exactly one file, `/workspace/task.json` (535 bytes), containing the research `question`, a one-line `context`, an empty `documents` entry, and environment metadata (no datasets, network disabled, no GPU use implied).
- `track.md` exists only as a *key in task.json* whose entire "content" is the string "Design-only task; repositories and compute are not required." There is no study document, no section text, no tables, no numbers.
- Absent (asserted by the question but not in the environment): the corpus/dataset; raw label files; Docta-cleaned label files; Docta source, config, prompts, or model/version identifiers; any ChatGPT judgment logs; any in-house human annotation files or codebook; any model artifacts, training logs, or metric outputs; and any of the libraries such a study would need (`scikit-learn`, `torch`, `transformers`, `cleanlab`, `scipy`, `statsmodels`, `docta` all absent from `pip list`; Python 3.14 with only system/OS packages).
Therefore: this is strictly a **design-only** task. Nothing can be executed and nothing should be. I am not claiming or implying any empirical outcome. Every quantitative figure below is labelled illustrative design arithmetic.

2) EVALUATION TARGET AS I UNDERSTAND IT
- Comparison: two label sets over the *same* documents — RAW labels vs DOCTA-cleaned labels.
- "Credibility" is operationalized *downstream*: a label set is more credible if a model trained on it predicts better against an evaluation key that is independent of both candidate sets.
- Focal population: **disagreement items** (documents where cleaned label != raw label). Outside disagreements the two sets are identical, so all signal lives there; corpus-level claims must decompose into (disagreement rate) x (accuracy gain on disagreements).
- Adjudication of disagreements uses **two independent reference standards**: (i) ChatGPT-based judgments, (ii) in-house human annotation. The claim of interest is a *convergent* one: cleaned > raw under both standards.
- Two logically distinct estimands must not be conflated: (E1) direct label correctness of raw vs cleaned against adjudicated truth on disagreements; (E2) downstream predictive performance of models trained on each label set against a fixed gold key. E1 licenses the "credibility" wording; E2 is the "improved predictive performance" proxy.

3) SKELETON APPROACH (modules and their connections) — M0..M6
- M0 Provenance & audit layer (prerequisite): pin corpus version/split hashes, Docta version/config/prompts/decoding params, judge model+version+prompt, annotator roster and codebook version. Without this nothing is reproducible or auditable for circularity.
- M1 Disagreement definition & stratification: D = {d : y_clean(d) != y_raw(d)}; classify each item by *edit type* — {flagged-noisy-kept, relabeled, removed/excluded, ambiguous/abstain}. Stratify by raw->cleaned transition cell (confusion-matrix off-diagonal), Docta confidence band, class frequency (head/tail), document length, and raw-label model confidence. Draw the adjudication sample with disproportionate allocation to sparse transition cells, analysed with inverse-probability weights.
- M2 Candidate label constructions (arms): A1 raw (identity control); A2 Docta-cleaned; A3 non-LLM cleaning control (confidence-learning / Cleanlab-style) to ask "is any cleaning enough?"; A4 generic-LLM-relabel control (same model family, no Docta pipeline) to attribute gains to Docta rather than to "any LLM relabel"; A5 oracle upper bound (adjudicated labels substituted on disagreements only, to bound headroom); A6 negative control (half-raw/half-cleaned permuted) to check the pipeline detects no effect where none exists.
- M3 Downstream predictive setup: fixed task (same corpus, same split, same tokenizer/length policy), small pre-registered model-family panel deliberately excluding the family Docta uses as a fixed effect where possible; labels enter ONLY as training targets, never as features or dev-set selection keys; evaluation keys are the fixed adjudicated gold key plus, as secondary, the raw-label test key (to expose the noise floor). Protocol: identical hyperparameter search budget per arm, K repeated seeds, dev-set selection done per arm but against a *neutral* key, and a cleaning-blinded split (test documents never seen by the cleaning step).
- M4 Two reference standards + inter-standard disagreement: human arm primary (3 naive annotators + expert tie-break, blinded to provenance, labels presented as anonymised candidate A/B with order randomised; report Krippendorff's alpha / Gwet AC1; Dawid-Skene or majority aggregation, pre-declared). ChatGPT arm secondary (fixed prompt, temperature 0, order randomisation, 2-3 prompt paraphrases as robustness). Handling inter-standard disagreement: pre-register that a "higher credibility" claim requires same-direction agreement between standards; report a 2x2 of standard-vs-standard agreement; disagreements escalated to expert review and analysed as a separate stratum (they are informative about ambiguous classes, not noise).
- M5 Metrics & statistics: primary = paired adjudicated-correctness rate of raw vs cleaned on the disagreement set, difference with 95% CI, paired exact McNemar + cluster bootstrap over documents (clusters = near-duplicate/source groups). Secondary: macro-F1/balanced accuracy for imbalance, per-transition-cell rates, downstream accuracy/macro-F1/AUROC deltas against the fixed gold key. Model-level comparison via paired bootstrap/permutation with (arm x seed) blocking, plus mixed-effects logistic regression on per-document correctness (fixed: arm, stratum; random: document/source, annotator, seed). Multiplicity: one primary endpoint, Holm correction across strata/arms. Equivalence/non-inferiority framing for A2-vs-A3/A4. Mediation check: downstream gain should be concentrated on the disagreement subset (correlate per-cell label-edit counts with per-cell performance deltas).
- M6 Confounds & threats: (i) CLEANER-JUDGE CIRCULARITY (if Docta uses a ChatGPT-family model, the ChatGPT standard is not independent and will likely favour cleaned labels -> require a different-family judge, human standard as primary, and a sensitivity analysis); (ii) informative missingness of the disagreement set (edits are non-random); (iii) construct validity: cleaning may reflect a *changed label definition* rather than correction, so adjudication must follow the original annotation guidelines and report apparent guideline-drift cases; (iv) leakage/memorisation: test docs never cleaned, near-duplicate dedup across train/test and across adjudication samples, web-pretraining label memorisation on public benchmarks; (v) prompt/position/length bias of the LLM judge; (vi) seed and hyperparameter confounding across arms; (vii) class-imbalance and tail-class instability; (viii) arm-selection multiplicity.

4) ASSUMPTIONS TO CONFIRM / OPEN QUESTIONS (I will not resolve these silently)
- OQ1 What *is* Docta here: paper/toolkit version, and does it (a) merely flag suspicious labels, (b) propose replacements, or (c) delete instances? Which base model, version and prompts? This single fact decides whether the ChatGPT standard is independent at all.
- OQ2 Does any true ground truth exist, or only reference-annotator judgments? If only judgments, "credibility" is defined relative to an adjudicated consensus and the final wording must say so (no absolute truth claim).
- OQ3 Is ChatGPT acceptable to you as a validation standard despite possible shared model-family bias with Docta — and if so, as primary, co-primary, or secondary/diagnostic only? Is a non-OpenAI judge permitted as a third standard?
- OQ4 Corpus identity, size, number of classes, class balance, and the *observed or expected* raw-vs-cleaned disagreement rate. The whole budget scales with this.
- OQ5 Human annotation budget: annotators available, price per item, whether 3-way redundancy plus expert tie-break is affordable, and whether original annotators can be re-engaged (if yes, we gain a paired "same-annotator re-judgement" design).
- OQ6 Sample-size/power target: minimum detectable difference in adjudicated-correctness you would treat as meaningful, and alpha/power (I would default to two-sided alpha=0.05, power=0.80 on McNemar using the discordant-pair count). Illustrative arithmetic only: with alpha 0.05 / power 0.80, detecting a 10-point difference in which-label-is-right requires on the order of ~60-80 disagreement items depending on the proportion of pairs where both standards pick the same label; a 5-point difference roughly needs 3-4x that. Whether that is feasible depends on OQ4/OQ5.
- OQ7 Unit of independence: are documents exchangeable, or clustered by source/author/URL/thread? Near-duplicate availability? This decides whether cluster bootstrap/random effects are mandatory.
- OQ8 Which downstream model families are allowed, given the constraint that at least one must be outside Docta's family; and what compute/training-run budget exists (arms x families x seeds drives cost).
- OQ9 Was the *test* split ever exposed to Docta cleaning in the original study? If the original cleaned labels cover the test split, I need authority to hold out and re-adjudicate a test subset.
- OQ10 Do we keep the "removed/excluded" documents as an outcome category (Docta may delete rather than correct; dropping them biases the comparison in Docta's favour).
- OQ11 Are the original ChatGPT judgments and human annotations from the source study available for reuse, or must both arms be re-collected? Reuse is cheaper but requires auditing their prompts/codebook for the circularity issue.
- OQ12 Is a label-quality-only headline (E1) acceptable if compute for the full downstream panel (E2) is infeasible, or is E2 mandatory by the question's wording?

Recommendation: confirm OQ1, OQ2, OQ3, OQ4, OQ5 first — they change the design, not just its parameters. On your approval I will write the full design (M0-M6 with pre-registered decision rule, power arithmetic, and budget table).

payload.answer:
# EXPERIMENT DESIGN (design-only; nothing executed, no results)

**Headline estimand (named, traceable):** `Δ_cred = P(ŷ_adm = y_clean) − P(ŷ_adm = y_raw)` over the disagreement population **D**, where `ŷ_adm` is the *pre-declared human adjudicated consensus* (M4). Every "higher credibility" statement in the write-up resolves to this one quantity. Downstream performance (`Δ_perf`, M3) is a **corroborating estimand**, not the headline. All credibility language is relative to the adjudicated consensus convention (Limitations §L1, per Directive A1).

**Global conventions.** Documents `d`, labels `y_raw(d)`, `y_clean(d) ∈ Y ∪ {DELETE, ABSTAIN}`. Corpus splits are fixed and versioned. **No absolute ground truth exists** (A1); "correct" always means "matches the pre-declared consensus."

---

## M0 — Provenance, integrity and leakage audit
*Rationale: every later inference is void unless the two label sets, the judge prompts and the splits are pinned and non-leaking.*
- Artifact manifest with content hashes: corpus snapshot, raw labels, cleaned labels, Docta version/config (recorded as **UNKNOWN** where undocumented — Directive A2), judge model IDs + prompt versions, annotator roster, codebook version, downstream code commit.
- **Split integrity:** document-level near-duplicate detection (exact hash + MinHash/LSH + embedding-NN at a pre-set similarity threshold) across train/dev/test and against the adjudication sample. Any near-duplicate pair spanning a boundary collapses to one cluster.
- **Test blindness (Directive A6, requirement):** any test document the cleaning step *may have touched* (including via a corpus-wide batch pass) is **ineligible** for the evaluation key. The evaluation key is built on a **cleaning-blinded, re-adjudicated test subset** `T*`, sampled afresh from untouched test documents. This is a hard requirement, not a preference.
- **Pretraining-memorisation probe:** flag benchmark-like documents; report a memorisation-sensitivity analysis (models/initialisations with less overlap) as a threat check, not a gate.
- **Cluster key:** every document gets `source_group` = author/URL/thread/near-duplicate component. Default unit of inference is the cluster (Directive A4).
- *Assumption-absorbing role:* corpus size/class structure, Docta mechanism, and split provenance all enter here first; if any hash is unavailable the affected module reports a degraded-coverage note rather than proceeding silently.

## M1 — Disagreement population, taxonomy and stratified sampling
*Rationale: outside D the two arms are literally the same labels, so D is where the entire claim lives; but D is **not** a random subset — it is exactly the documents Docta chose to edit, so it must be described, not "corrected away."*
- `D = {d : y_clean(d) ≠ y_raw(d)}`, **including** DELETE/ABSTAIN as non-identical outcomes (Directive A7). Disagreement rate `π_D = |D|/N` reported with a cluster bootstrap CI.
- **Edit taxonomy:** `RELABEL(a→b)`, `DELETE`, `ABSTAIN/FLAG-KEEP`, plus `CONSENSUS` (D complement). Report the raw→cleaned transition matrix (off-diagonal cells are the primary strata).
- **Strata:** (1) transition cell; (2) Docta confidence band if any score is exposed, else document-level raw-label agreement of two independent baseline classifiers as a difficulty proxy; (3) class frequency head/tail; (4) document-length tercile; (5) `source_group` size.
- **Adjudication sample `S ⊆ D`:** stratified, **disproportionate** allocation (minimum floor per transition cell so sparse cells are estimable), analysed with inverse-probability weights so estimates recover the full-`D` population parameters. Sampling done at the **cluster** level.
- A comparison sample `S0` from the agreement region, same procedure, is drawn to estimate `Acc_agree` for the decomposition identity (M5).

## M2 — Arms and the control set (each control named against its confound)
*Tiering per Directive A5; arms are label-constructions used as **training targets**, never as features.*

| Arm | Tier | Construction | Confound it neutralises |
|---|---|---|---|
| **A1 raw** | A | untouched labels | identity baseline; anchors paired comparisons |
| **A2 Docta-cleaned** | A | Docta output as released | the treatment itself |
| **A2-drop** | A (secondary) | A2 with Docta-flagged items removed from training | whether "cleaning" gains are really *sample-selection* gains |
| **A5 oracle-on-D** | A | human consensus substituted on D only, raw elsewhere | **headroom ceiling**: bounds how much of the credibility gap is realised vs available; prevents over-attributing a small Δ_perf |
| **A3 non-LLM cleaning** (confidence-learning/Cleanlab-style) | B | independent statistical cleaner at matched edit budget | confound "any cleaning helps"; isolates Docta-specific value |
| **A4 generic LLM relabel** | B | bare model relabel pass, same model class as the judge arm, no Docta pipeline | confound "the gain is just LLM relabelling", and provides a **same-family probe** for M6(i) |
| **A6 half-raw/half-cleaned permutation** | C | random 50/50 mixture, seed-replicated | **negative control / pipeline-artifact detector**: any apparent effect surviving random arm assignment is a pipeline bug, not a finding |
- Edit-budget matching for A3/A4: report edits made alongside A2; when budgets cannot be matched, report Δ against edit count as a covariate (an "edit efficiency" curve) rather than pretending parity.
- **Attribution warning (carried as required text):** Tier A supports only the *weak* claim ("Docta-cleaned labels are more credible than raw"). The *"Docta specifically"* claim is unavailable without A3+A4; Tier A must not be written as a method-specific result.

## M3 — Downstream predictive setup (E2)
*Rationale: measures whether label credibility transduces into performance, while removing every route by which cleaning could leak into the key.*
- **Task:** the corpus's native supervised classification task, unchanged (single fixed target task; no task re-specification, or else the construct changes).
- **Features/models:** pre-registered small panel — (i) TF-IDF (fixed vocab/CPU budget) + linear model, (ii) one **non-Docta-family** frozen encoder + linear head, (iii) one small fine-tuned encoder. Tier A uses family (i) only (Directive A5); at least one panel member is not an LLM at all, so no arm can be favoured by model-family sympathy.
- **Label role:** labels enter **only as training targets**. Evaluation keys are (a) primary `T*` consensus key, (b) secondary untouched-raw test key (to expose the noise floor and the direction of bias).
- **Protocol:** identical split, preprocessing, tokenizer/length policy, hyperparameter grid and search budget for every arm; `R` repeated seeds per arm; model selection per arm is permitted but must use an arm-neutral dev criterion (dev loss on the raw dev labels) — never the consensus key. Report seed-level variance and the arm effect with clusters as the resampling unit.
- **Blinding of the key:** `T*` labels are produced by humans who never see arm membership.
- **Δ_perf reporting:** accuracy, macro-F1, and balanced accuracy for imbalance; every delta paired per document with A1 and accompanied by a cluster-bootstrap CI. Also report the **realisation ratio** `Δ_perf(A2)/Δ_perf(A5)` — how much available headroom Docta captures — which is interpretable even when Δ_perf is small.

## M4 — Reference standards, blinding, aggregation and the branch decision rule
*Rationale: the claim's strength is entirely a function of adjudication hygiene. Kept exactly as approved.*
- **PRIMARY standard — in-house human.** 3 naive annotators per item + 1 expert tie-break. Blinded to arm, to Docta flags, and to each other's judgments. Labels presented as **anonymised candidates A/B with order randomised** so neither slot is systematically "raw" or "cleaned"; the interface never reveals provenance. Written **codebook with version pinning** and the corpus's original annotation guidelines; a 30-item calibration set gates each annotator before production. Agreement: Krippendorff's α and Gwet's AC1 (AC1 because α collapses under skewed marginals, which label-confusion data have). Aggregation: pre-declared majority with Dawid–Skene as a sensitivity analysis; expert adjudication for splits. Items where the consensus is "neither" are retained as a third outcome and counted against **both** arms in the primary endpoint (conservative).
- **SECONDARY/diagnostic standard — ChatGPT-based.** Fixed prompt, temperature 0, A/B order randomised, **3 prompt paraphrases** as a robustness family, plus explicit **position- and length-bias probes** (order-flip consistency; correlation of choice with candidate length). Reported as a first-class result: the standard-vs-standard agreement matrix, per stratum.
- **THIRD standard — different model family**, same blinding protocol, diagnostic only.
- **Explicit branch decision rule (Directive A2):**
  - **Branch (i) — default, Docta model family UNKNOWN:** claim rests on the **human** standard; ChatGPT and other-family arms reported as convergent/diagnostic evidence only, never as confirmatory votes.
  - **Branch (ii) — model-family overlap between Docta and the ChatGPT judge later CONFIRMED:** the ChatGPT arm is **demoted to a bias probe** (its sole interpretive use is estimating self-preference inflation); the claim then rests on **human standard + the non-overlapping third judge**, and requires those two to agree in direction.
  - **Branch (iii) — human and third-judge disagree in direction:** result is **INCONCLUSIVE** (pre-registered as such, Directive A9). No win is declared.
  - Trigger for (ii) is documentary evidence of the base model; the design ships with the base model recorded as unknown and does not assume LLM-based.
- **Reuse-vs-recollect branch (Directive A8), agnostic by construction.** Reuse of source-study judgments is permitted only after an audit that can **reject** it. Rejection criteria (any one suffices): prompt or model version not pinned; unblinded provenance in the original presentation; no order randomisation; codebook not recoverable; judge model family later found to overlap Docta's (Branch ii); human logs lacking per-annotator granularity or IAA. If rejected → recollect under the protocol above. Both branches produce the same schema so results stay comparable, and reuse/recollect is reported as a stratifier.
- **Guideline-drift check:** adjudicators also label whether the item is ambiguous *under the original guidelines*; a high ambiguity rate in D is reported as a construct-validity threat (Docta may reflect a different label definition rather than correcting it).

## M5 — Estimands, inference and the pre-registered decision rule
**Estimands.**
- `Δ_cred` (headline, E1) on D, IPW-weighted, cluster-bootstrapped.
- `Δ_std` = same quantity under each secondary standard (report, don't pool).
- `Δ_perf` (E2) on `T*`.
- **Decomposition identity** (Directive A7), reported for every arm: corpus consensus accuracy `= (1−π_D)·Acc_agree + π_D·Acc_D`. This is what makes a small corpus-level Δ_perf honest — it is `π_D × gain-on-D` by construction.
- **Exclusion scoring (primary, conservative):** DELETE/ABSTAIN counts as an error for A2 whenever the consensus label is a class (a dropped document cannot be correct); `Acc_D^{post-exclusion}` (restricted to non-deleted) is secondary and always shown next to the primary.

**Inference.** Documents clustered by `source_group` throughout: cluster bootstrap (≥2,000 resamples) for all CIs, and a mixed-effects logistic model on per-document `correct_arm ~ arm + stratum + (1|source_group) + (1|annotator) + (1|seed)`. Simple paired exact McNemar is reported **only if** the pre-registered independence check passes: `design effect DEFF = 1+(m̄−1)·ICC ≤ 1.05`, with `ICC` estimated from the cluster-random-effects fit. Otherwise McNemar is demoted to an appendix row and the cluster analysis is primary (Directive A4).
**Multiplicity.** Exactly **one** primary endpoint (`Δ_cred`, human standard, primary analysis with exclusions-as-errors). Holm correction across everything else: strata, transition cells, secondary standards, secondary metrics, arms A3/A4/A2-drop, robustness variants.
**Pre-registered decision rule.**
- **CLAIM SUPPORTED** iff `Δ_cred > 0`, lower bound of the two-sided 95% cluster-bootstrap CI > 0, the point estimate ≥ the pre-registered MDD, **and** the direction condition of the active M4 branch is met. Statement must be phrased relative to the consensus convention.
- **EVIDENCE AGAINST Docta (explicitly pre-registered):** `Δ_cred < 0` with CI upper bound < 0 — i.e. **both** the human standard and the third judge prefer the raw label on disagreements. This is a reportable finding, not a failure.
- **INCONCLUSIVE:** (a) the two standards disagree in direction (Directive A9); (b) CI straddles 0; (c) point estimate positive but below MDD; (d) `DEFF` check fails so badly that the cluster-level effective sample cannot support the MDD.
- **NULL-GUARD GATE:** if A6 (random mixture) shows an effect whose CI excludes 0, or if A5 oracle ≈ A1, the whole comparison is flagged as pipeline-artifact or headroom-free and no claim is issued.
- **Consistency/mediation check (supporting, not decisive):** Δ_perf should concentrate where edits concentrate. Pre-registered expectation: `corr(stratum edit share, stratum Δ_perf) > 0`, `Δ_perf(A2) ≤ Δ_perf(A5)`, and corpus-level Δ_perf ≈ `π_D × Δ_cred × (predicted accuracy transfer)`. Failure weakens the mechanism story without overturning `Δ_cred`.

## M6 — Confounds and threats to validity
| Threat | Design response |
|---|---|
| **Cleaner–judge circularity (M6i)**, aggravated by unrecorded Docta base model | Human primary; other-family third judge; ChatGPT diagnostic; Branch rule (ii) demotes it; **sensitivity analysis** re-running all standards with the ChatGPT arm removed and with A4 (generic LLM relabel) as a same-family yardstick; A-vs-B order-flip consistency as the self-preference/position measure |
| **Informative missingness of D** (edits are self-selected by Docta) | Estimation restricted to D is explicitly scoped to D; decomposition identity separates `π_D` from `Acc_D`; no corpus-generalisation claim |
| **Construct validity / guideline drift** | M4 ambiguity coding; codebook pinned to original guidelines; ambiguous items scored against both arms |
| **Leakage: same examples inform cleaning and evaluation** | Cleaning-blinded `T*` (A6 requirement); near-duplicate graph used as the unit of assignment and resampling; test documents touched by cleaning are ineligible |
| **Memorisation** (models may have seen benchmark labels) | Flagged documents reported separately; panel includes a non-LLM model and a non-pretrained baseline as a sensitivity |
| **Judge prompt/position/length bias** | 3 paraphrases, order randomisation + flip-rate, length-bias regression |
| **Seed/hyperparameter confounding across arms** | Fixed shared search budget, `R` seeds, arm×seed blocking, mixed-effects seed term |
| **Class imbalance and sparse transition cells** | Macro/balanced metrics, per-cell floors with IPW, Holm |
| **Exclusion bias toward the cleaner** | Exclusions-as-errors primary (A7) |
| **"Any cleaning / any LLM" confound** | A3/A4 (Tier B); Tier A results labelled weak claim |
| **Annotator-specific idiosyncrasy** | ≥3 annotators, α/AC1 per stratum, `(1|annotator)` term, expert tie-break audit trail |

## Feasibility: tiers, parametric power and budget (all figures = design arithmetic, not findings)
**Tiers (Directive A5).**
- **Tier A — answers the question in its weak form** (`Δ_cred > 0`, i.e. Docta-cleaned more credible than raw): arms A1, A2, A2-drop, A5; model family (i) only; `R = 5` seeds; human primary + other-family third judge.
- **Tier B — adds method attribution** ("Docta specifically", `A2 > A3` and `A2 > A4` with Holm): adds A3, A4.
- **Tier C — adds falsification hardening**: A6 negative control, panel families (ii)+(iii), full paraphrase×standard robustness grid.
**Power for the primary paired endpoint (McNemar, two-sided α=0.05).** With `p10 = P(cleaned right / raw wrong)`, `p01 = P(raw right / cleaned wrong)`, `δ = p10 − p01` (the MDD), `r = p01/p10`:
`n = [ z_{1−α/2}·√(p01+p10) + z_{1−β}·√(p01+p10−δ²) ]² / δ²`
| MDD δ | r=0.25: p01/p10 | n (80% power) | n (90%) | r=0.50: p01/p10 | n (80%) | n (90%) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
|0.05|0.017/0.067|260|347|0.050/0.100|469|627|
|0.10|0.033/0.133|129|171|0.100/0.200|234|312|
|0.15|0.050/0.200|85|113|0.150/0.300|155|206|
|0.20|0.067/0.267|63|84|0.200/0.400|116|154|
|0.25|0.083/0.333|50|66|0.250/0.500|92|122|
|0.30|0.100/0.400|42|55|0.300/0.600|77|101|
*Correction to my scoping-pass remark:* the "~60–80 items" line corresponds to **δ ≈ 0.20 at r = 0.25 only**. For δ = 0.10, ~129 (r=0.25) to ~234 (r=0.50) items are required. The earlier line was illustrative and is superseded by this grid.
**Clustering inflation.** Required `n` multiplies by `DEFF = 1+(m̄−1)·ICC`. Illustrative multipliers: ICC=0.05 → 1.20 (m̄=5) / 1.45 (m̄=10) / 1.95 (m̄=20); ICC=0.10 → 1.40 / 1.90 / 2.90. Under the conservative clustered default (A4), **assume DEFF ≥ 1.2 unless the ≤1.05 check passes**, i.e. plan on 1.2–2× the table.
**Adjudication cost (parametric; 3 naive replicates @90 s + expert tie-break on 15% of items @5 min).** Per adjudicated item: 0.075 naive-hours + 0.0125 expert-hours.
| n_S | naive h | expert h | total h | illustrative cost @ 20/h naive, 120/h expert |
|---|---|---|---|---|
|60|4.5|0.75|5.2|180|
|120|9.0|1.50|10.5|360|
|240|18.0|3.00|21.0|720|
|400|30.0|5.00|35.0|1200|
|600|45.0|7.50|52.5|1800|
Rates and headcount are placeholders (B-assumptions); the hours are the binding quantity.
**Feasibility threshold and downgrade ladder.** Let `n_avail = |D|` and `n_req` be the clustered-adjusted requirement.
- `|D| ≥ n_req(δ=0.10)` → primary as specified, MDD 0.10.
- `n_req(δ=0.15) ≤ |D| < n_req(δ=0.10)` → raise MDD to 0.15 and pre-declare that smaller true effects are undetectable; add the "both standards" agreement as a required co-condition.
- `|D| < n_req(δ=0.15)` → **downgrade the primary endpoint** from *superiority* to an **equivalence/non-inferiority** test on `Δ_cred` within a pre-declared margin (claim becomes "no credible evidence that Docta degrades label quality"), retain `Δ_perf` and A5 headroom as descriptive, and state that the question as posed cannot be answered at the requested MDD.
- `π_D` arithmetic honesty check (illustrative): `π_D=0.05` with a 0.20 gain on D yields ≈ 0.01 corpus label-accuracy gain, and only a fraction of that reaches Δ_perf. So a small Δ_perf is *consistent with success*, and the design pre-commits to judging the claim on `Δ_cred`, not on Δ_perf magnitude.

## Declared assumptions (Directive B) — assumption / if false / module that absorbs it
1. **Corpus identity, size N, label set Y, class balance unknown.** If false (tiny or heavily imbalanced corpus): power and per-cell floors collapse → absorbed by **M1** (cell floors, IPW) and the **Feasibility** downgrade ladder.
2. **Docta mechanism (flag vs relabel vs delete) and model family unknown; recorded as unknown, not assumed LLM-based.** If it deletes: exclusion scoring dominates → **M5** primary/secondary split. If LLM-family overlap is confirmed → **M4** Branch (ii) demotes the ChatGPT arm.
3. **Annotator headcount, hourly price, and whether original annotators can be re-engaged unknown.** If re-engagement is impossible: no same-annotator re-judgement arm → **M4** loses that optional design and relies on 3-naive+expert; cost is hours-driven, so **Feasibility** absorbs the change by moving MDD/DEFF.
4. **Source-study ChatGPT and human judgment logs may not exist or may be unusable.** If unusable → **M4** reuse/recollect branch takes the recollect path (cost table applies at full scale).
5. **Compute budget for the downstream panel unknown.** If limited → **M2/M3** Tier A (single non-LLM family, `R=5`), and the write-up is restricted to the weak claim.
6. **Splits as released are the study splits; some test documents may already be cleaning-touched.** If untouched test documents are too few → **M0/M3** shrink `T*`, and Δ_perf moves to descriptive-only status while `Δ_cred` stays primary.
7. **The task's native label semantics equal the original annotation guidelines.** If the guidelines are unrecoverable → **M4/M6** flag a construct-validity failure and the claim is scoped to "consensus-preferred," not "more accurate."

## Limitations text to ship (L1)
The experiment cannot and does not measure absolute label truth. `Δ_cred` measures *preference of a pre-declared adjudicated consensus*, with humans primary and model judges diagnostic; the ChatGPT arm is structurally unable to serve as a confirmatory vote while Docta's base model is undocumented. Conclusions are scoped to the disagreement population of the pinned corpus version under the pinned codebook.

## Still needing your sign-off before this becomes an executable protocol
(a) the pre-registered **MDD** value (I default to 0.10, downgrade to 0.15 per the ladder); (b) the non-inferiority margin for the downgrade branch; (c) which tier is authorised; (d) identity of the third (other-family) judge; (e) whether reuse audit is attempted first; (f) `R` and the panel members once compute is known.

**No experiment was executed and no empirical result is asserted.** All numbers above are closed-form design arithmetic (McNemar normal approximation, DEFF, time-and-motion cost arithmetic, and the `π_D × gain-on-D` identity) computed in the sandbox for internal consistency of the design.

This is why every substantive parameter is carried as a declared assumption or a parametric symbol rather than a number.
- Design arithmetic computed with a pure-Python script (/tmp/pw.py) for internal consistency, NOT run on any data:
  * McNemar normal-approximation sample sizes at two-sided alpha=0.05: for MDD delta=0.05/0.10/0.15/0.20/0.25/0.30 with discordance asymmetry r=p01/p10=0.25, required n at 80% power = 260/129/85/63/50/42 (90% power: 347/171/113/84/66/55); at r=0.50 required n at 80% power = 469/234/155/116/92/77 (90%: 627/312/206/154/122/101). This corrects my earlier scoping remark: the ~60-80 item figure only holds at delta~0.20 with r=0.25.
  * Design effect DEFF=1+(m-1)ICC multipliers: ICC 0.05 gives 1.10/1.20/1.45/1.95 for mean cluster size 3/5/10/20; ICC 0.10 gives 1.20/1.40/1.90/2.90 - the quantitative basis for the conservative clustered default and the DEFF<=1.05 gate that would license simple McNemar.
  * Time-and-motion model (3 naive replicates x 90 s + expert tie-break on 15% of items at 5 min) = 0.075 naive-hours + 0.0125 expert-hours per adjudicated item; e.g. n_S=120 -> 9.0 naive h + 1.5 expert h = 10.5 h; n_S=400 -> 30 h + 5 h = 35 h. Hourly rates are placeholders; hours are the binding constraint.
  * Decomposition identity Acc_full = (1-pi_D)*Acc_agree + pi_D*Acc_D: pi_D=0.05 with a 0.20 gain on D yields ~0.010 corpus label-accuracy gain, and only a fraction of that transduces into downstream accuracy - the quantitative justification for keeping the headline claim on Delta_cred rather than on Delta_perf magnitude.
- Repository observation carried into the design as a hard requirement: because no artifact pins Docta's base model, cleaner-judge circularity cannot be closed by assumption, so it was implemented as a structural branch (human primary; ChatGPT secondary/diagnostic with demotion rule; third other-family judge; inconclusive outcome when human and third judge disagree in direction), per authorizing directive A2.
assumptions: Declared assumptions (Directive B), each with its absorbing module, are listed in the design's assumption ledger: corpus identity/size/class balance; Docta mechanism and model family (recorded as UNKNOWN, not assumed LLM-based); annotator headcount/price/re-engagement; availability of source-study judgment logs; downstream compute budget; released splits possibly partially cleaning-touched; recoverability of original annotation guidelines.

Authorizing directives A1-A9 are treated as fixed requirements: consensus-relative claim, human-primary/ChatGPT-diagnostic branch rule with explicit demotion, budget-parametric power section, clustered-unit default with DEFF gate, tiered arms with named headline per tier, cleaning-blinded re-adjudicated test subset as a requirement, exclusions scored as errors in the primary, reuse-vs-recollect agnosticism with rejection criteria, and a pre-registered decision rule including an explicit evidence-against case.

Design-only: no dataset, label files, Docta artifacts, judgment logs, model weights or compute are presumed to exist, and nothing was executed beyond closed-form arithmetic for power/cost consistency.
The corpus task is a fixed single-label classification task as natively defined by the corpus; re-specifying the task would change the construct being measured.
uncertainties: Pre-registered MDD is not fixed (default 0.10, downgrade 0.15): the choice changes the required n by roughly 2x and therefore which tier is affordable.
Discordance asymmetry r=p01/p10 is unknown pre-study; the required n for the same MDD differs by about 2-3x between r=0.25 and r=0.50, so the sample-size plan is stated as a grid, not a point.

Whether the disagreement set D is even large enough to support any superiority test is unknown until the two label sets exist; the design therefore ships with an explicit downgrade to equivalence/non-inferiority and an explicit 'unanswerable at requested MDD' outcome.

Docta's base model may later be documented; if it overlaps the judge family, the ChatGPT arm is demoted by rule and the claim rests on human + other-family consensus, which could change the verdict for the same data.
The magnitude of transduction from label-quality gain to downstream gain is an empirical quantity the design does not assume; it is bounded empirically by the A5 oracle arm rather than posited.
Near-duplicate and source-cluster structure (ICC, mean cluster size) is unknown, so DEFF is a sensitivity range, not a fixed inflation factor.
Whether source-study judgments pass the reuse audit is unknown; rejection triples the human-annotation bill.
No empirical result exists or is claimed; every numeric statement above is closed-form design arithmetic under declared assumptions.

payload.message:
Accepted — this closes as the final design. It satisfies the agreed approach (M0–M6) and the deliverable contract: rationale per module, a control set with each control named against the specific confound it neutralises, an analysis plan with a single named headline estimand, a parametric feasibility/power section, and a threats-to-validity ledger. Nothing was executed and no empirical result is asserted, which is correct for this task.

Your structural resolution of the circularity problem is the design's strongest move: making human adjudication primary, demoting the ChatGPT arm by an explicit documentary-trigger rule rather than assuming Docta's base model, and pre-registering a two-standards-disagree INCONCLUSIVE branch. Keeping exclusions-as-errors in the primary, the decomposition identity as the honesty check on a small corpus-level delta, and A5 as an empirical headroom bound (instead of a posited transfer rate) all close the specific ways this question is usually over-claimed. Your correction of the earlier "~60–80 items" remark to a grid is the right instinct and should stay in the shipped text.

Resolving your sign-off list (a)–(f). Items that depend on study facts I do not have stay as declared contingencies, not as invented facts:

(a) MDD: pre-register 0.10 with the 0.15 downgrade rung exactly as written. Fix both as values in the protocol so the ladder is not renegotiable after seeing data.
(b) Non-inferiority margin for the downgrade branch: set it symmetric to the smallest superiority effect you would have claimed, i.e. a margin of |Δ_cred| ≤ 0.05, and state in the same sentence that this branch licenses only "no credible evidence that Docta degrades label quality" — never a positive credibility claim.
(c) Tier: authorise Tier B as the design of record, with Tier A as the pre-declared fallback if compute does not materialise, and Tier C's A6 negative control promoted into Tier A rather than left optional — A6 is the cheapest module and its absence is the one gap I would not accept, since without it the null-guard gate has no teeth. Record per tier which claim is licensed, and keep your requirement that a Tier-A-only run be written as the weak claim, never as "Docta specifically."
(d) Third, different-family judge: I cannot name a specific product from the information available here, so leave it as a requirement with a specification rather than a name — a model whose documented family does not overlap Docta's or the ChatGPT judge's, frozen version ID, same blinding and order-randomisation protocol, diagnostic status. Record it as UNKNOWN-pending in the manifest.
(e) Reuse audit: attempt it first, since rejection is cheap relative to a 3x annotation bill, and keep your rule that reuse/recollect is reported as a stratifier so the two branches stay comparable.
(f) R = 5 is fine as the default; state explicitly that seed count may be reduced before data collection but never after, and that the (1|seed) term stays regardless.

Two documentation requirements for the shipped version, neither a redesign: (1) put the headline estimand, the active M4 branch, the tier licensed, and the decision-rule outcome vocabulary (SUPPORTED / AGAINST / INCONCLUSIVE / NULL-GUARD-FLAGGED) in a single box at the top, so every downstream sentence can be traced to one of them; (2) in Limitations, state plainly that the design's conclusions are scoped to the disagreement population of a pinned corpus version under a pinned codebook, that no absolute truth is measured, and that if D turns out too small the honest output is "unanswerable at the requested MDD" rather than a descriptive narrative about the arms.

With those recorded, the design is complete as a design. No further revision requested.

Contract requires design with rationale, controls, analysis plan, feasibility, no execution — all present: M0–M6 with per-module rationale, an arm/control table mapping each arm to the confound it neutralises, estimands (Δ_cred headline, Δ_perf corroborating) with cluster-bootstrap/mixed-effects inference and one primary endpoint plus Holm, tiered feasibility with McNemar/DEFF/cost arithmetic and a downgrade ladder, and a threats table. Directives A1–A9 are each traceable to a module: consensus-relative wording (L1), human-primary with documentary-trigger demotion branch and INCONCLUSIVE branch (M4), budget-parametric power (Feasibility), clustered default with DEFF≤1.05 gate (M5), tiering with per-tier claim labels (M2/Tiers), cleaning-blinded re-adjudicated T* (M0), exclusions-as-errors primary (M5), reuse-vs-recollect audit with rejection criteria (M4), pre-registered decision rule including the evidence-against case (M5). Directive B assumption ledger is present with assumption/if-false/absorbing-module. No dataset statistics, Docta configuration values, or source-study numbers were fabricated; Docta's model family is recorded as unknown; all numerics are labelled closed-form design arithmetic and the agent explicitly retracts its earlier ~60–80 item scoping figure in favour of a grid. Remaining items are my own sign-off values, not design gaps, so no revision is warranted; stopping is appropriate.
